decisions.reason: The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the ergonomic office portfolio and has its own page, but desk lamps are a competitive, non-core segment.
The second-generation general interior luminaire is core to the building lighting business and recently refreshed.

Withdrawing the naval lighting line signals a retreat from marine niches, and the HMI discharge technology conflicts with the LED focus, but spare-part continuity for marine customers argues for keeping it one more year.
The marine searchlight serves robust specialist customers with long lifecycles, though the naval line's withdrawal raises the risk of a broader marine pruning.
